newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia, Iran sign $145 mln deal on airplane engines.
newsitem.headline: Russia, Iran sign $145 mln deal on airplane engines.

text.p: Russia's military aircraft manufacturer MAPO said on Friday it had signed an agreement on Friday to licence the production of 60 aircraft engines by Iranian State Industrial Aircraft Company.
MAPO issued a statement saying that the agreement to build TB7-117 engines had been signed in Tehran on Thursday. The statement put the price of the deal at $145 million.
MAPO spokesman said that the engines were to power An-140 aircraft recently ordered by Iran in Ukraine. He did not give the total number of ordered planes.
The TB7-117 engines were designed by MAPO's St Petersburg subsidiary Zavod imeni Klimova.
